territories.name: Solomon Islands
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Solomon Islands levies no value added tax: the Inland Revenue Division administers a goods tax under the Goods Tax Act (Cap. 122), at 10 per cent on prescribed locally manufactured goods and 15 per cent on imported goods, and a sales tax under the Sales Tax Act (Cap. 125) on the goods and services of its Schedule One, and a registered person files a monthly return for each, form GT4 and form ST4, within 30 days of the end of the month.
